I will keep my land mainly in the wheat-maize rotation, because that is what fits Quzhou County best and it matches how I farm at my age. I want a steady harvest, not too much market risk, and work that I understand well and can manage without making things too complicated. At the start of this growing season, the winter wheat is already in the field, so I will finish the wheat crop first, then plant summer maize right after harvest. I will use improved seed for wheat and hybrid seed for maize because I care about stable yield and strong stand establishment. I will not spread my land across too many crops, since that adds labor, management difficulty, and sales uncertainty. For field work, I will keep fertilizer rates moderate, irrigate at the key stages, spray only as needed but still in a practical scheduled way, and use rotary tillage because it is efficient and familiar for me.
